title: CTS Evangelism — Unit 11: Types of Evangelists (Bilingual)

blocks.en: 📖 Evangelism — Unit 11: Types of Evangelists and Approaches to Evangelism
blocks.es_reference: 📖 Evangelismo — Unidad 11: Tipos de Evangelistas y Enfoques del Evangelismo

blocks.en: Chapala Theological Seminary · Dr. Wayne Cook, Author and Professor · Dr. Ted Rogers, Seminary Director
blocks.es_reference: Seminario Teológico de Chapala · Dr. Wayne Cook, Autor y Profesor · Dr. Ted Rogers, Director del Seminario

blocks.en: Orientation
blocks.es_reference: Orientación

blocks.en: Not all believers share the gospel in the same way. While the responsibility to evangelize belongs to every Christian, the manner in which that responsibility is expressed may differ. Scripture presents a unified message but allows for diversity in approach. Understanding the different ways believers engage in evangelism helps remove unnecessary guilt, encourages participation, and allows each believer to function more effectively within their God-given strengths.
blocks.es_reference: No todos los creyentes comparten el evangelio de la misma manera. Aunque la responsabilidad de evangelizar pertenece a todo cristiano, la manera en que esa responsabilidad se expresa puede diferir. Las Escrituras presentan un mensaje unificado, pero permiten diversidad en el enfoque. Comprender las diferentes maneras en que los creyentes participan en el evangelismo ayuda a eliminar la culpa innecesaria, fomenta la participación y permite que cada creyente funcione más eficazmente dentro de las fortalezas que Dios le ha dado.

blocks.en: I. Unity of Message, Diversity of Approach
blocks.es_reference: I. Unidad de Mensaje, Diversidad de Enfoque

blocks.en: The gospel itself does not change:
blocks.es_reference: El evangelio mismo no cambia:

blocks.en: "For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ, for it is the power of God to salvation for everyone who believes." (Romans 1:16, NKJV)
blocks.es_reference: "Porque no me avergüenzo del evangelio de Cristo; porque es el poder de Dios para salvación a todo aquel que cree." (Romanos 1:16, RVG)

blocks.en: However, the way it is communicated may vary. Paul wrote:
blocks.es_reference: Sin embargo, la manera en que se comunica puede variar. Pablo escribió:

blocks.en: "There are diversities of gifts, but the same Spirit." (1 Corinthians 12:4, NKJV)
blocks.es_reference: "Ahora bien, hay diversidad de dones; pero el Espíritu es el mismo." (1 Corintios 12:4, RVG)

blocks.en: This principle applies directly to evangelism. The message is fixed, but the approach may differ from believer to believer.
blocks.es_reference: Este principio se aplica directamente al evangelismo. El mensaje es fijo, pero el enfoque puede diferir de creyente a creyente.

blocks.en: II. The Direct Evangelist
blocks.es_reference: II. El Evangelista Directo

blocks.en: Some believers are naturally direct. They are comfortable initiating conversations, clearly presenting the gospel, and calling for a response. Peter demonstrated this on the day of Pentecost:
blocks.es_reference: Algunos creyentes son naturalmente directos. Se sienten cómodos iniciando conversaciones, presentando claramente el evangelio y llamando a una respuesta. Pedro lo demostró en el día de Pentecostés:

blocks.en: "Repent, and let every one of you be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins." (Acts 2:38, NKJV)
blocks.es_reference: "Arrepentíos, y bautícese cada uno de vosotros en el nombre de Jesucristo para perdón de los pecados." (Hechos 2:38, RVG)

blocks.en: This approach is clear and bold. It is especially effective where there is openness and urgency. However, it must be balanced with sensitivity, lest boldness become harshness.
blocks.es_reference: Este enfoque es claro y audaz. Es especialmente eficaz donde hay apertura y urgencia. Sin embargo, debe equilibrarse con sensibilidad, no sea que la valentía se vuelva dureza.

blocks.en: III. The Relational Evangelist
blocks.es_reference: III. El Evangelista Relacional

blocks.en: Others engage through relationships developed over time. Paul wrote:
blocks.es_reference: Otros se involucran por medio de relaciones cultivadas con el tiempo. Pablo escribió:

blocks.en: "So, affectionately longing for you, we were well pleased to impart to you not only the gospel of God, but also our own lives." (1 Thessalonians 2:8, NKJV)
blocks.es_reference: "Tan grande es nuestro afecto por vosotros, que hubiéramos querido entregaros no sólo el evangelio de Dios, sino también nuestras propias almas." (1 Tesalonicenses 2:8, RVG)

blocks.en: This approach emphasizes trust, consistency, and ongoing interaction. It may take longer, but it allows for deeper influence as the relationship earns a hearing for the gospel.
blocks.es_reference: Este enfoque enfatiza la confianza, la constancia y la interacción continua. Puede tomar más tiempo, pero permite una influencia más profunda a medida que la relación gana un oído para el evangelio.

blocks.en: IV. The Serving Evangelist
blocks.es_reference: IV. El Evangelista que Sirve

blocks.en: Some believers communicate the gospel through acts of service. Jesus said:
blocks.es_reference: Algunos creyentes comunican el evangelio a través de actos de servicio. Jesús dijo:

blocks.en: "Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works and glorify your Father in heaven." (Matthew 5:16, NKJV)
blocks.es_reference: "Así alumbre vuestra luz delante de los hombres, para que vean vuestras buenas obras, y glorifiquen a vuestro Padre que está en el cielo." (Mateo 5:16, RVG)

blocks.en: Service opens doors for conversation and demonstrates the reality of the gospel in practical ways. However, service must be accompanied by a verbal explanation of the gospel, or it remains only kindness without its source named.
blocks.es_reference: El servicio abre puertas para la conversación y demuestra la realidad del evangelio de maneras prácticas. Sin embargo, el servicio debe ir acompañado de una explicación verbal del evangelio, o permanece solo como bondad sin nombrar su fuente.

blocks.en: V. The Apologetic Evangelist
blocks.es_reference: V. El Evangelista Apologético

blocks.en: Some are particularly effective in addressing questions and objections. Peter instructed:
blocks.es_reference: Algunos son particularmente eficaces en abordar preguntas y objeciones. Pedro instruyó:

blocks.en: "But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts, and always be ready to give a defense to everyone who asks you a reason for the hope that is in you, with meekness and fear." (1 Peter 3:15, NKJV)
blocks.es_reference: "sino santificad a Dios el Señor en vuestros corazones, y estad siempre preparados para responder con mansedumbre y reverencia a todo el que os demande razón de la esperanza que hay en vosotros." (1 Pedro 3:15, RVG)

blocks.en: This approach is valuable when engaging individuals who have intellectual or philosophical barriers. It requires knowledge, clarity, and patience.
blocks.es_reference: Este enfoque es valioso al tratar con personas que tienen barreras intelectuales o filosóficas. Requiere conocimiento, claridad y paciencia.

blocks.en: VI. The Invitational Evangelist
blocks.es_reference: VI. El Evangelista que Invita

blocks.en: Some believers are effective in inviting others to encounter the gospel in a different setting. When Nathanael raised a doubt, Philip simply said:
blocks.es_reference: Algunos creyentes son eficaces en invitar a otros a encontrarse con el evangelio en otro entorno. Cuando Natanael planteó una duda, Felipe simplemente dijo:

blocks.en: "And Nathanael said to him, 'Can anything good come out of Nazareth?' Philip said to him, 'Come and see.'" (John 1:46, NKJV)
blocks.es_reference: "Y le dijo Natanael: ¿De Nazaret puede haber algo de bueno? Le dijo Felipe: Ven y ve." (Juan 1:46, RVG)

blocks.en: This may involve inviting someone to church, bringing them to a Bible study, or introducing them to another believer. It works well when combined with other forms of evangelism.
blocks.es_reference: Esto puede implicar invitar a alguien a la iglesia, llevarlo a un estudio bíblico o presentarlo a otro creyente. Funciona bien cuando se combina con otras formas de evangelismo.

blocks.en: VII. The Testimonial Evangelist
blocks.es_reference: VII. El Evangelista que Testifica

blocks.en: Some share effectively through personal testimony. The man healed of blindness said:
blocks.es_reference: Algunos comparten eficazmente a través del testimonio personal. El hombre sanado de ceguera dijo:

blocks.en: "One thing I know: that though I was blind, now I see." (John 9:25, NKJV)
blocks.es_reference: "Una cosa sé: que habiendo yo sido ciego, ahora veo." (Juan 9:25, RVG)

blocks.en: Personal testimony is powerful because it is authentic, relatable, and difficult to refute. However, it must be connected to the gospel message itself, not left as a mere story of personal improvement.
blocks.es_reference: El testimonio personal es poderoso porque es auténtico, cercano y difícil de refutar. Sin embargo, debe estar conectado con el mensaje del evangelio mismo, no quedar como una mera historia de superación personal.

blocks.en: VIII. Avoiding Comparison and Guilt
blocks.es_reference: VIII. Evitar la Comparación y la Culpa

blocks.en: A common mistake is comparing one approach to another and assuming that only one is valid. Scripture teaches diversity within unity. Each believer should understand their strengths, develop their ability, and remain faithful to the message. No single approach is superior in all situations.
blocks.es_reference: Un error común es comparar un enfoque con otro y suponer que solo uno es válido. Las Escrituras enseñan diversidad dentro de la unidad. Cada creyente debe comprender sus fortalezas, desarrollar su capacidad y permanecer fiel al mensaje. Ningún enfoque es superior en todas las situaciones.

blocks.en: IX. Developing Balance
blocks.es_reference: IX. Desarrollar el Equilibrio

blocks.en: While believers may lean toward one approach, they should seek to grow in others. A relational evangelist should learn to speak clearly. A direct evangelist should learn sensitivity. A serving evangelist should learn to articulate the gospel. Balance strengthens effectiveness and guards against the weaknesses of any single style.
blocks.es_reference: Aunque los creyentes pueden inclinarse hacia un enfoque, deben buscar crecer en otros. Un evangelista relacional debe aprender a hablar con claridad. Un evangelista directo debe aprender sensibilidad. Un evangelista que sirve debe aprender a articular el evangelio. El equilibrio fortalece la eficacia y protege contra las debilidades de cualquier estilo único.

blocks.en: X. Illustration and Application
blocks.es_reference: X. Ilustración y Aplicación

blocks.en: Consider a group of believers. One speaks boldly and directly. Another builds relationships over time. Another serves faithfully. Another answers questions thoughtfully. Each is different, yet all are participating in the same mission. The effectiveness of evangelism is not found in uniformity, but in faithful diversity.
blocks.es_reference: Considere a un grupo de creyentes. Uno habla con audacia y de manera directa. Otro construye relaciones con el tiempo. Otro sirve fielmente. Otro responde preguntas con reflexión. Cada uno es diferente, pero todos participan en la misma misión. La eficacia del evangelismo no se encuentra en la uniformidad, sino en la diversidad fiel.

blocks.en: Conclusion
blocks.es_reference: Conclusión

blocks.en: Evangelism allows for diversity in approach while maintaining unity in message. Each believer has a role to play. When these approaches are understood and practiced faithfully, the church becomes more effective in reaching a variety of people in different contexts.
blocks.es_reference: El evangelismo permite diversidad en el enfoque mientras mantiene unidad en el mensaje. Cada creyente tiene un papel que desempeñar. Cuando estos enfoques se comprenden y se practican fielmente, la iglesia se vuelve más eficaz en alcanzar a una variedad de personas en diferentes contextos.

blocks.en: "And there are diversities of activities, but it is the same God who works all in all." (1 Corinthians 12:6, NKJV)
blocks.es_reference: "Y hay diversidad de operaciones; pero es el mismo Dios que obra todas las cosas en todos." (1 Corintios 12:6, RVG)

fill.prompt: The gospel message is fixed, but the ____ may differ from believer to believer.
Paul wrote, "There are diversities of gifts, but the same ____" (1 Corinthians 12:4).
Peter demonstrated the direct approach on the day of ____, calling his hearers to repent and be baptized.
The direct approach must be kept in balance, lest boldness become ____.
Describing relational ministry, Paul was pleased to impart not only the gospel of God, "but also our own ____" (1 Thessalonians 2:8).
Service opens doors, but it must be accompanied by the ____ explanation of the gospel, or it remains only kindness without its source named.
The apologetic evangelist heeds Peter: "always be ready to give a ____ to everyone who asks you a reason for the hope that is in you" (1 Peter 3:15).
When Nathanael raised a doubt, ____ simply said, "Come and see" (John 1:46).
Personal testimony is powerful because it is authentic, relatable, and difficult to ____.
Rather than comparing approaches, remember that Scripture teaches diversity within ____.

sa.prompt: Explain the principle of 'unity of message, diversity of approach' using Romans 1:16 and 1 Corinthians 12:4.
sa.model: Romans 1:16 declares the one unchanging gospel is the power of God to salvation, and 1 Corinthians 12:4 shows there are diversities of gifts but the same Spirit. Together they teach unity of message, diversity of approach: the gospel itself is fixed and shared by all, but the ways believers carry it differ according to their gifts and personalities. The message never changes; the approaches rightly vary, so different witnesses reach different people with the same saving truth.

sa.prompt: Describe the direct evangelist (Acts 2:38). What are its strengths and the danger it must guard against?
sa.model: The direct evangelist, modeled by Peter in Acts 2:38, confronts hearers plainly with their need to repent and believe. Its strengths are clarity and boldness — it states the gospel without evasion and calls for immediate response. The danger it must guard against is insensitivity: pressing so directly that it runs over people, ignores their questions, or wounds rather than wins. Directness is a gift when joined to love, but harsh when it forgets the person it addresses.

sa.prompt: Explain the relational approach to evangelism using 1 Thessalonians 2:8. Why might it take longer but reach deeper?
sa.model: 1 Thessalonians 2:8 shows Paul so loved the Thessalonians that he shared not only the gospel but his own life. The relational approach builds trust through genuine friendship and shared life before and alongside the verbal witness. It may take longer because trust grows slowly, but it reaches deeper because the gospel comes from someone the hearer knows and believes cares for him. The investment of relationship gives the message credibility and access that a one-time encounter cannot.

sa.prompt: Discuss the serving evangelist (Matthew 5:16). Why must service be accompanied by a verbal witness?
sa.model: The serving evangelist witnesses through deeds of love, and Matthew 5:16 says let your light shine so others see your good works and glorify God. Service must be accompanied by a verbal witness because good works alone can be admired without anyone learning of Christ; people may praise the kindness yet never hear the gospel. Deeds open the door and demonstrate the love of Christ, but words are needed to name Him and explain the salvation those deeds point toward.

sa.prompt: Explain the apologetic approach using 1 Peter 3:15. What qualities does it require?
sa.model: 1 Peter 3:15 calls believers to always be ready to give a defense for the hope within them, yet with gentleness and respect. The apologetic approach answers questions and objections, giving reasons for faith. It requires knowledge of the gospel and of common objections, but equally the qualities of gentleness and respect — answering not to win an argument but to win a person. The apologist removes intellectual barriers while keeping the tone humble, so reason serves love rather than replacing it.

sa.prompt: Describe the invitational and testimonial approaches (John 1:46; John 9:25). Why is personal testimony powerful?
sa.model: The invitational approach simply brings others to see, as Philip told Nathanael 'Come and see' (John 1:46). The testimonial approach tells one's own story, as the healed blind man said 'one thing I know, that whereas I was blind, now I see' (John 9:25). Personal testimony is powerful because it is hard to argue against a changed life: the witness is not debating theory but reporting what God has actually done for him. His story makes the gospel concrete and credible.

sa.prompt: Why is comparing one approach to another a mistake? Explain how Scripture teaches diversity within unity.
sa.model: Comparing one approach to another is a mistake because it breeds either pride or false guilt: the bold witness may look down on the quiet one, and the relational witness may feel inferior to the direct one. Scripture teaches diversity within unity — the same Spirit gives different gifts (1 Cor 12), all serving one body. No single approach is the standard for all. Each believer should witness according to his God-given design rather than measuring himself against another's style.

sa.prompt: Explain why believers should develop balance, growing beyond their natural approach. Give an example.
sa.model: Believers should develop balance, growing beyond their natural approach, because relying only on one's default leaves whole kinds of people unreached. A naturally relational witness, for example, may be comfortable building friendships but avoid ever directly calling for a decision; he should grow in boldness so that his warm relationships actually lead someone to Christ. Developing the other approaches stretches the believer to meet people his natural style would miss, making him a more complete and useful witness.

sa.prompt: Using the illustration of the group of believers, explain why effectiveness is found in faithful diversity, not uniformity.
sa.model: The illustration of a group of believers, each witnessing differently, shows that effectiveness is found in faithful diversity, not uniformity. If all witnessed identically, they would reach only one kind of person; because they differ — one direct, one relational, one serving, one apologetic — together they reach many. Effectiveness comes not from everyone adopting the same style but from each being faithful to his own gifting, so the body as a whole touches every kind of heart with the one gospel.

sa.prompt: Synthesize the unit: how does 1 Corinthians 12:6 ground the truth that diverse approaches serve one mission under one God?
sa.model: 1 Corinthians 12:6 says there are diversities of operations, but the same God works all in all. This grounds the truth that diverse approaches serve one mission under one God: the variety of styles is not competition or contradiction but the design of the one God who distributes different gifts for a single purpose. The relational, direct, serving, apologetic, invitational, and testimonial approaches are all the same God working through different believers to accomplish the one mission of reaching the lost with the one gospel.
